'''2018 European Championship Day 3 Bastian Winkelhaus LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] at [[2018 European Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (location)|Hoth-L-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127125624/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-championships/ Internet Archive]
